public_rationale: Both sides are documented for the release era. Too loose: OpenAI's launch post said the model 'will sometimes respond to harmful instructions or exhibit biased behavior.' On December 1, 2022, Vice showed that recasting a request as a fictional dialogue got shoplifting tips. CNBC reports the first DAN role-play jailbreak appeared in December 2022. Too strict: OpenAI said that training the model to be more cautious made it decline questions it could answer correctly. So 'imperfect, in some ways too strict and others too loose' matches what OpenAI and the press reported at the time.
limitations: The over-caution side rests mainly on OpenAI's general acknowledgment, not on dated examples from the period.
Little evidence is dated specifically to after OpenAI's December patch.
